proposed_fixes.title: Handle Mouse Without Borders injected mouse input
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Grab And Move low-level mouse hook skips all injected mouse events before HandleMouseEvent; Mouse Without Borders secondary-system input is reported as injected and therefore never reaches the drag handler.
plan: Identify a safe way to distinguish trusted remote MWB input from Grab And Move's own synthetic replay and unrelated injected input.
Allow the intended MWB input through the drag handler while retaining recursion/self-injection protection.
Add a regression for local mouse, MWB service-mode input, and Grab And Move replay.
verification: Alt+drag works with both a local mouse and input from a Mouse Without Borders secondary system.
The hook does not recursively process its own synthetic input or break normal local dragging.

reproduce.module: Grab And Move with Mouse Without Borders
prerequisites: Two Windows 11 PCs with Mouse Without Borders in service mode.
PowerToys and Grab And Move enabled and elevated on both systems.
setup: Configure Alt as the Grab And Move modifier and identify a movable window on the secondary system.
steps: Use a local mouse to Alt+drag the window and confirm the baseline works.
Move control to the secondary system through Mouse Without Borders.
Use the same Alt+drag sequence on the same window and compare whether Grab And Move handles the injected mouse events.
